Daily life duas

8 duas

All duas

  • Dua before sleepingIn Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
  • Dua after waking upAll praise is for Allah, who gave us life after He caused us to die, and to Him is the return.الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
  • Dua before eatingIn the name of Allah. (If forgotten:) In the name of Allah, at its beginning and at its end.بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
  • Dua after eatingAll praise is for Allah, who fed me this and provided it for me without any power or strength from me.الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
  • Dua for leaving the houseIn the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no power and no strength except with Allah.بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
  • Dua for entering the toiletO Allah, I seek refuge in You from the male and female devils (all evil and impure things).اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
  • Dua for leaving the toilet(I ask) Your forgiveness.غُفْرَانَكَ
  • Dua when sneezingAll praise is for Allah. (Reply:) May Allah have mercy on you. (Then:) May Allah guide you and set your affairs right.الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
